text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, August 20, 2022, Appeal DDRT2023-02.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Rescinded the determination of a dangerous dog and exempted the Applicant from compliance with the Dangerous Dog Order issued August 20, 2022, and directed that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Lori Allan and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before March 10, 2023.
